title: AskAnswer
description: Folder- or library-scoped Ask. Answers cite the saves they used; a citation-less answer is a bug, not a style (Rules.md).

scope.description: Echo of the requested `save_scope` (folder id or `library`).

engine.description: Cloud by default; Local runs on-device and must show the `running on device · slower` hint in UI.

anchor.description: Timestamp / heading anchor for the chip to open the note at.
